first_sentence: 這是打嗝！因為胸口下面的膜突然跳了一下。
facts: 橫膈膜是幫助我們呼吸的一塊膜
膜突然一抽，空氣就很快被吸進來
空氣撞到喉嚨的小門，就發出嗝聲
ask_back: 打嗝的時候，會發出什麼聲音？

bridges.has_dog: 狗狗打嗝的時候，肚子也會一抽一抽嗎？

author: claude-haiku

en.first_sentence: This is a hiccup! A muscle under your chest jumps suddenly.
facts: A thin muscle under your lungs helps you breathe.
When it jumps suddenly, air rushes in very fast.
The air hits a little door in your throat, and it goes hic!
en.ask_back: Do you think a drink of water can stop your hiccups, or not?

bridges.has_dog: When your dog hiccups, does its tummy jump too?
